scope: Independent source review; completion of the data audit is asserted only by its separate audit.json.
review: Reconstructs the fixed 18-case matrix with sign mirrors, all schedules, 11 methods, physical cap, seed rule and released source/review/boundary bindings.

Recomputes exact integer fair crossing probabilities of all eight finite boundary tables. Jeffreys tail cutoffs additionally satisfy independent binomial-coefficient crossing and adjacent-state inequalities.
Reconstructs every recorded block with the three prescribed same-seed binomial calls and accounts for all four physical categories and paid shots.
Reconstructs fine Fisher blocks and the coarse initial 32-shot aggregate, then identical later block partitions. Shared conditional-CGF arithmetic is explicitly disclosed.

Requires every active method at every released eligible checkpoint; reconstructs integer certificates and all continuous screens/certificates. Every stored outcome must equal the independently reconstructed first certified stop or forced-cap prefix.
Requires 576 ordered paths, 6336 corresponding method rows and terminal certificates, no extra ledger rows and 36 exact original-runner seed replays at repetitions 0 and 31.
Independently reconstructs main/positive/negative/null outcomes and all unconditional costs/ratios, retaining wrong decisions and cap abstentions.
Rehashes producer inputs, auditor sources and released bindings after audit; exclusive output creation preserves previous artifacts.
limits: First-stop checks refer to the released checkpoints and screens, not all hypothetical mathematical crossings.
Outward interval, log-marginal and conditional-CGF primitives are shared with frozen reviewed sources. Original-runner seed replays are separately labelled reproducibility checks.
The integer-table risk statements are finite-horizon model guarantees. Audit success does not establish simulator fidelity, novelty, held-out superiority or SOTA status.
This source review does not assert that the full data audit has finished or passed.
